coverage.goal: Rename getCwd to getCurrentWorkingDirectory everywhere.
coverage.step_history:
- s1 kind=execute status=done: rename the function definition

  close_report=done
  outcome=success
- s2 kind=execute status=done: update all call sites
  expected=all callers updated
  close_report=done
  outcome=success
- s3 kind=execute status=done: run the test suite
  expected=all tests pass
  close_report=done
  outcome=success
